title: Golf Strength - Pre Season
author: Anton Hørning
desc:
A pre season weight training program for golfers to improve their strength and power before the season starts
Focus on generating transferable strenght for the sport of golf
Your skill specific training should always take center stage though

ex.note:
Ensure proper form
Use dumbbells or barbell

Keep a slight bend in the knees
Push hips back for proper posture
Stand on a box or elevated surface for deeper stretch
Go heavy, but leave something in the tank

Any lunge variation is suitable
Reps are per side

Hold the bench for support & lift 1 leg
Contract glutes & hamstrings
Reps per side

Lower slowly to the side and stand straight up explosively - do not overextend
Make sure to do both sides

Get into a golf stance
Rotate torso for power
Make sure to do both sides
Lie on your back, bend knees and keep feet flat on floor. Place hands on thighs and try to slide them over the top of your knees
Alternate between dumbbells & barbell every few weeks

Stand straight up
Shoulder press above your head
Bring dumbbells together without touching
Engage the core for balance

Pull up your weight by contracting your back
Don't use body momentum

Use lighter weight moved quickly
or
Go heavy with lower reps

Grab with both hands
Extend arms out at shoulder height
Twist around until the band touches your body
Repeat for both sides

Do not use momentum
Lower legs controlled
Move the ball from one side to the other
